Definition: properly, a pithy maxim, usually of metaphorical nature; hence, a simile (as an adage, poem, discourse)
BiblicalUsage: 1) proverb, parable; 1a) proverb, proverbial saying, aphorism; 1b) byword; 1c) similitude, parable; 1d) poem; 1e) sentences of ethical wisdom, ethical maxims
